title: Run one cell (POST /sessions/<id>/run)
description: No command field exists on purpose: the controller builds the command from the cell and the validated flags (schemas/cells.json, ALLOWED COMMAND). Answers {runId} (HTTP 202); 400 with a message for an unknown cell or a bad flag; 409 while another run is active in the session (one run at a time per sandbox); 404/410 for an unknown or ended session.
